expected_result: each mutation must be rejected by JSON Schema 2020-12 validation
claim_ceiling: These are schema-level rejection cases, not evidence of an executed validator or a security proof.

cases.description: A simulation receipt claims to be a real-world observation.
A simulation receipt claims permission to authorize real actions.
A simulation receipt claims permission to reserve real resources.
A simulation receipt claims it can settle real assets.

The record attempts to broaden its evidence claim ceiling.
A simulated event attempts to declare a real payment effect.
A profile assigns an unknown socioeconomic regime.
A profile digest has no valid SHA-256 identity prefix and length.
A record tries to add an undeclared, potentially authority-bearing field.
